body:
**What changed**
- **Script mods:** the manager now installs files below `ProjectPBZ/Content/JavaScript`, as script mods such as Mods Menu need. Before, those scripts stayed out of the install, so such a mod was incomplete.
- **Refresh:** the Mods page has a **Refresh** button next to the search box. It checks the mods folder again without a restart, as F5 does.
- **Note before install:** a new mod of type Game files or Exe files shows a short note first, because it goes into the game's folders and may conflict with other tools or loaders. It is only a note, not an error.
- **Blue rows:** mods of those two types have a blue row in the list.
- **Window size:** the window no longer goes below its start size, 1360 × 800. A screen too small for that gets a window that fits.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.5.5.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
